observations: Photo 0 shows one old domestic sewing machine on a tiled floor, with a power cord and a black electric foot pedal beside it.
The front panel reads 'IDEAL TOPSTAR' and below it 'Super Automatic' in script, legible in photo 0.
Stitch selector dials and coloured stitch charts on the right panel; a small label reads 'UNTEN OBEN', so it is a German-market machine.
It is a portable electric zigzag style machine, not a hand-crank or treadle machine.
The body is dirty with grime on the base and bed, a pink mark on the free arm, yellowed paint; it looks old and well used.
Needle plate and presser foot are in place; no bobbin case, accessories, carry case or cover are shown.
Only one photo; rear, underside, bobbin area and a running test are not shown.

identity.kind: electric domestic sewing machine with foot pedal
read_from: photo 0 front panel 'IDEAL TOPSTAR Super Automatic'

claims.evidence: Photo 0 front panel reads 'IDEAL TOPSTAR Super Automatic'.
Photo 0 shows a power cord and an electric foot pedal; this is an electric machine, not a hand or treadle machine.
Photo 0 shows heavy grime on the base and bed, a pink stain on the free arm and yellowed paint; it is an old, well used machine.
No clip of the machine running or stitching.
No receipt or warranty shown; for a machine of this age a warranty is unlikely.
Location cannot be confirmed from the photo.

risks.risk: Motor, pedal or wiring faulty; old cord insulation may be damaged
risks.proof: A clip of the machine plugged in, pedal pressed, sewing a zigzag and a straight seam on cloth

risks.risk: Seized mechanism, timing off or broken internal gears from age and dirt
risks.proof: The same stitching clip, plus the handwheel turned by hand showing the needle moving freely

risks.risk: Bobbin case, bobbin or accessories missing
risks.proof: A photo with the bobbin cover open showing the bobbin case, and all accessories laid out
risks.if_unproven: as missing bobbin case and accessories

risks.risk: Voltage: a German-market machine may be fine on local mains but the motor rating is unconfirmed
risks.proof: A photo of the rating plate on the rear or underside
risks.if_unproven: as needing a check before use

risks.risk: Cracks or damage on the rear or underside
risks.proof: Photos of the rear and underside

proof_requests: A clip of the machine plugged in and sewing a straight and a zigzag seam on cloth
A photo with the bobbin cover open showing the bobbin case
A photo of the rating plate on the rear or underside
Photos of the rear and underside
A photo with a handwritten note of today's date beside the machine
response.reason: The front panel in photo 0 reads Ideal Topstar Super Automatic, an old electric domestic sewing machine, so it can be priced at worst case as used, dirty and not working. The seller's 'manual' and 'like new' are contradicted by the photo, and function stays a condition until a stitching clip is shown.
